chapter: New Orleans memories and early drumming
title: What Ory taught him about rhythm
summary: Hall credits Ory with insisting on good plain rhythm rather than fancy playing.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Yeah, a good right foot. Good foot too. Yeah, yeah, that guy, his pedal was bent, I don't know whether the weight he put on it or what. That guy could play a show with his foot. I imagine that was that fast, see. But he was just a little different from us. See, Ori, that's one thing about I give Ori credit for him, he always liked good rhythm. He didn't want all that fancy stuff in there, but he wanted good rhythm. And that's why I think I got a lot of credit from what he taught me, you know. I give him that credit. He really put me on the ball when it comes down to that.
